title: Toɗɗaaɗo Ardiiɗo Leñol
intro: E jamaanu caɗeele mawɗe e ŋakkeende yaakaare wonande leñol, toɗɗagol Alla waɗaama. Oo neɗɗo, mo heewɓe njiylotonoo e fuɗɗoode, ko Alla suɓii ɗum ngam ardaade leñol e gaño kulɓiniiɗo. Daartol maɓɓe ko seedantaagal doole goonɗinal e hakkille gonɗo caggal yamiroore Alla, hollirnde wonde ardorde goonga tawaaka e nokkuuji ɗaminaaɗi.
clues: Mi suɓaama e Allah ngam wonde ardotooɗo leñol am nde ɓe ɗaɓɓi laamɗo ngam haɓde e laawol makko.
Yimɓe am ina naamnoo toɗɗagol am e fuɗɗoode, ina cikka ko woɗɓe ɓuri fotde sabu jawdi mum en walla leñol mum en.
Maande ardorde am fotnde wonde ko gartugol kees ceniɗo, ina waɗi geɗe annabaaɓe ɓennuɓe, addanɗe deeƴre.
Mi ardii konu am haa maayo, mi jarribii ɗooftaare maɓɓe, mi haɗi ɓe yarde ko ɓuri ɓuuɓri ndiyam.
Hay so tawii heddiiɓe ɓee ina pamɗi caggal jarribo ngoo, min kawri e jaambaaro mawɗo e konu mum en.
E yamiroore am, suka gorko gooto jeyaaɗo e konu am, mo wonaano haɓoowo lolluɗo, haɓi e cuusal, fooli kaɓirgal gaño kulɓiniingal.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Laamu sosaa e jawdi e doole keewɗe.
Yimɓe ɓee njiliima e ilam mawɗam.
Jaambaaro gaño foolaa, Alla hokki nasaraaku.
Yoro mawngo toɗɗii leydi ndii duuɓi.
Ardiiɗo oo ko tagoore mawnde moɗi ɗum.
outcome.answer: Jaambaaro gaño foolaa, Alla hokki nasaraaku.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
